summary: The filing is an 8-K (Item 8.01 Other Events) by First Bancorp, Inc. to announce a press release declaring a quarterly cash dividend. The dividend is $0.38 per share, up $0.01 from prior quarters, payable July 17, 2026 to holders of record July 7, 2026. No special situation is present—this is a routine dividend declaration by the issuer.
